edges.note: The contents cover brain-implanted BioMEMS micromachine neuroelectrodes, implantable sensors, microelectrode array fabrication, brain-machine interfaces, polymer BioMEMS electrodes, retinal devices and microscale therapeutic neurostimulation. This is the human-effects and human-interface leg of the AAWSAP survey, alongside Kit Green's field-effects paper and Richard Genik's three neuro deliverables.
